items.title: George Benson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: Oh yeah, at the Vanguard, right.

He used to talk to me about Charlie Christian. He told me I was going to be the second Charlie Christian. Then he told me that when he came to New York, he was like Art Tatum. He said, “I was only 17 years old. I scared everybody to death.” That’s what he said. It was fun talking to him, because he was so different. But he was definitely a genius. I found that all those cats who had those weird reputations – “Oh, he’s crazy. Miles is crazy.” No, the one thing I know, Miles ain’t crazy. And Thelonious Monk? A…
Did you get a chance to play with him? With Monk?
